senses.gloss: स्तुति- + पाठक स्तुति- + पाठक, m. a panegyrist, a herald.
स्तुति- + व्रत स्तुति- + व्रत, m. a bard, a herald.

स्तु स्तु, ii. 2, Par. Ātm.
 1. To praise, Rām. 2, 65, 53; ved. Ātm. To be praised, Chr. 294, 7 = Rigv. i. 92, 7 (स्तवे instead of स्तवते, i. 1).
 2. To worship by hymns, MBh. 1, 721.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, ष्टु, To praise, Pañc. 172, 14.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To praise, Rām. 1, 14, 26.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To praise, Mālat. 76, 13.
 2. To begin, Utt. Rāmac. 162, 10; [] Mālav. 13, 21.
 3. To say, to report, Hit. 100, 16. प्रस्तुत,
 1. Praised.
 2. Declared, Mālat. 16, 15; vowed, Hit. 120, 21.
 3. Approached.
 4. Desired, expected.
 5. Prepared, ready, being at hand, Hit. 87, 21.
 6. Done.
 7. Made of.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. To cause to begin, MBh. 1, 6. प्रस्तावित, Caused to be told, Mālat. 47, 1.
 --With वि वि, ष्टु, To praise, MBh. 1, 7056.
 --With सम् सम्, To praise, Indr. 2, 9. संस्तवान, Eloquent. संस्तुत,
 1. Praised, Rājat. 5, 9.
 2. Known, Utt. Rāmac. 76, 2.
 --Comp.
 अ-, 1. disagreeing, Śāk. d. 33. 2. unfit, Pañc. i. d. 41 (but cf. v. r., Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 404).
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To praise, MBh. 3, 12709.
 --With परिसम् परि-सम्, To praise, MBh. 1, 2122.
 --Cf. perhaps Æol. στύμα, στόμα (questionable, on account of Zend. श्तमन्, the muzzle).
† स्तुच् स्तुच्, i. 1, Ātm. To be clear, to be propitious.
ऽस्तुत् -स्तु + त्, latter part of comp. words, Praising; e. g. छन्दस्-, adj. Praising by hymns, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 8.

स्तुति स्तु + ति, f. Praise, Sund. 2, 4; Utt. Rāmac. 136, 6.
 --Comp.

स्तुभ् स्तुभ्,
 1. (i. e. स्तु-भा), i. 1, Par. To praise.
 2. † i. 1, Ātm. To stupify, to be stupified; cf. स्तुम्भ्.
 --Caus. ved. To praise, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 88, 6.
 --With प्रति प्रति, ष्टुभ्, ved. To praise, ib.

† स्तुम्भ् स्तुम्भ्, ii. 5, स्तुभ्नु, and 9, स्तुभ्ना, नी (cf. स्तम्भ्), Par.
 1. To stop (cf. Rigv. v. 54, 1).
 2. To stupify.
 3. To expel.
 --Cf. στῡ́ϕω, στῦϕελός, στυμνός, στυϕεδανός, and τυϕεδανός, probably τυϕλός, τυϕώδης; perhaps O.H.G. stumph, stumbal; A.S. stypel; Goth. and A.S. dumb.
† स्तूप् स्तूप्, i. 4 and 10, Par. To heap, to pile.

स्तूप स्तूप, m.
 1. A heap, a pile, a Bauddha construction for keeping holy relics.
 2. A funeral pile.
